title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Microsoft Fabric and Power BI risk indicators
summary: Hold: the assurance that taking no action produces no new charge is not explicitly documented for the Fabric indicators. The roadmap details, indicator examples, licensing, meter and control routes are supported, but two routes stop before the final selection and the billing procedure needs its customer-scope qualification.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans ready-to-use Insider Risk Management indicators for Microsoft Fabric activity in Power BI.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management extends its risk detection capabilities to Microsoft Fabric products by offering ready-to-use risk indicators based on activities that may lead to a data security incident in Power BI.

claims.claim: The indicators are disabled by default and require administrator selection, supporting admin-opt-in.

claims.claim: Leaving the Fabric indicators unselected does not enable their new monitoring.
claims.quote: Global settings indicators: Indicators enabled in global settings for Insider Risk Management define both the indicators available for configuration in policies and the types of events signals collected by Insider Risk Management.

claims.claim: If nobody acts there is no new charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Fabric Insider Risk Management indicators disabled not selected no cost incurred; Fabric indicators charges disabled; read policy-indicators, billing-models and PAYG enablement. Explicit no-cost text concerns deselected generative AI apps, not Fabric indicators.
claims.fix: Remove 'and no new charge' from the sentence. Keep the documented statement that the indicators are disabled by default.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: risk and cost
claims.claim: Fabric indicators use the data security processing unit meter, supporting a variable cost rating.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management indicators that detect activity in cloud storage apps (Box, Dropbox, Google Drive), cloud services (AWS, Azure), and Microsoft Fabric (Power BI) are billed on data security processing units.

claims.claim: For IRM a processing unit is the compute needed to process 10,000 relevant user activities.
claims.quote: For Insider Risk Management, a processing unit represents the compute required to process 10,000 such user activities. Billing is based on the number of processing units utilized.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges appear on an Azure bill generated at the end of the month.
claims.quote: An Azure bill is generated at the end of the month for the total number of pay-as-you-go charges across all Microsoft solutions.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 tenant must be associated with an active Azure subscription.
claims.quote: The billing mechanisms are Azure based, so you must associate your Microsoft 365 tenant with an active Azure subscription.

claims.claim: The Fabric indicators do not by themselves stop a sensitivity-label change.

claims.fix: Replace 'They do not by themselves stop the change; Learn describes them as detections' with 'Learn describes these indicators as detections of changes to protection.'
